actual_call.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. ONE square premium real studio catalog photograph with exactly TWO FULL VIEWS of the SAME silver showerhead: front on left, rear on right. NO THIRD VIEW, NO SIDE VIEW, no text. Image1 real silver front photo, image2 real silver back photo, image3 real side photo are the appearance/geometry authority. Image4 untextured gray side model is SECONDARY ONLY to explain continuous curvature, not its gray material. Image5 A034 is STYLE ONLY for front/back co-display, not its different product, tube, filter, water, dimensions or claims.
CRITICAL LAYOUT: 1:1 square canvas, plain white/pale neutral gray seamless studio. Top14% (about175pixels in1254) must be EMPTY for title; bottom12% (150pixels) EMPTY for labels. Two complete uncropped products upright, aligned top and threaded bottom, each about72% canvas height, centered x30% and x73%. Generous gap, no overlap. Left front oriented nearly straight toward camera, showing entire black face and both real controls. Right actual back, front face NOT visible. Complete lower handles and short bare SILVER threaded ends. Do not magnify product to fill entire canvas.
TRUE PRODUCT: bright mirror SILVER smooth curved shell/handle and true cylindrical head edge, shallow rear dome continuously flowing through a long gentle neck into lower grip. Same exact head-to-handle proportions across views. Do not invent a narrow pinched waist/abrupt shoulder, big rear bubble, straight racket stick or extra rear features. Back is one clean uninterrupted silver shell with broad photographic studio reflections: NO circular spot/patch/sticker/button/scale mark; the gray circle in input2 is not a product feature and must not be reproduced. Remove hand/bathroom/person/ceiling grid reflections; use neutral clean softbox reflections.
Front real fine-textured BLACK teardrop face with the true organized dense white-ring nozzle array and outer concentric tiny DARK hole border. Every white ring must be ONE crisp separate off-white circular ring surrounding ONE dark opening. All rings have clean edges, no triangular tails, melted smears, connected pairs or duplicated ghost rings; preserve original spacing and shape at this larger front-view size. Central RED control must retain real small low-wide flange with smaller concentric raised boss and dark center opening. No oversized torus/new black disc. Lower separate rounded-rectangle selector is shiny SILVER in black insert, not black. Photographic material character, not gray clay CGI.
Dry resting product only. NO person, hand, finger, water, spray, extended needles, arrows, labels, logos, claims, certificates, tube/filter, hose, holder or quick-release adapter. Remove photographed connection accessories while preserving actual handle; short bare SILVER thread only. Same soft balanced studio lighting for both views, subtle contact shadows, no props. Do not copy the reference's wrong product or typography.
